description: A clean and simple PvP texture pack.
body:
# PvP Texture Pack

A clean and simple PvP texture pack designed to improve combat visibility and make PvP more enjoyable.

## Features

* Custom Sword Textures
* Custom Golden Apple Texture
* Custom Water Bucket Texture
* Custom Lava Bucket Texture
* Custom Totem of Undying Texture
* Custom Wind Charge Texture
* Custom Firework Rocket Texture
* Custom Cobweb Texture

## Why use this pack?

This pack focuses on important PvP items, making them look cleaner and easier to recognize during battles while keeping the vanilla Minecraft feel.

Perfect for:

* Crystal PvP
* SMP Servers
* Duels
* Survival Multiplayer

Feedback and suggestions are always welcome!
